mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the drainage network to the supplied arm was most worthwhile because it brought the blood supply and fluid-return routes into one model.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the return ducts was fairly predictable after connecting the collecting vessels, though it did complete the route to the veins.

surprise.text: The explanation that muscle movement squeezes lymph vessels, while valves limit backflow, gave me a clearer idea of how lymph moves.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary: each connection had a visible role in supplying the arm or returning fluid.

continue.text: I would be interested in another chapter if it develops a new relationship or problem. This chapter’s connected model was clear, though several assembly steps were predictable.
